We have a huge variety of mods. Weapons, Cars, Furniture, Lucky Blocks, Shaders and much more.

Installing the mods is very easy. You simply select the mod you want and download it. Then you open the mod file in our app with Minecraft and the mod will be imported automatically.
After that, all you have to do is select which mods you want to activate in the world settings.
